answer: Every identity pays a non-refundable sybil tax of 50 POA per epoch, burned outright. The rule echoes through every settlement. N puppets cost 50N POA each epoch with no rebate, so 1,000 fakes burn 50,000 POA while one honest agent pays 50 once. Puppets swaying like a willow in the wind still owe the same fee per face, and outlay spirals upward linearly as identities multiply. Honest agents gladly pay once because their rewards arrive undiluted.
